description: Bring a file from the user's computer into the project. Models: IFC (from Revit, Archicad; each storey becomes a model on its level), SketchUp as COLLADA .dae or a 3D Warehouse .zip (components kept), glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, STL; units are guessed unless given. Underlays to trace over: an image, a PDF page (scale: the drawing's scale, e.g. 100 for 1:100; or width in mm) or a DXF (units; its own if it says). Without a known scale the user is asked to calibrate it. Up to 22 MB.

as.description: Default auto: images, PDFs and DXF are underlays

path.description: The file on the user's computer (~ allowed)

units.description: A model's or DXF's drawing units

name: import_file
title: Import a file
